result.topic_en: Riemann forms the second-order variation expression for the quadratic form $\sum p_{\iota\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'}$ with second-order variations chosen to satisfy auxiliary conditions, applies it to the form $(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3)^2+2c\,ds_2ds_3$, and derives a condition relating $\partial^2 c/\partial s_2\partial s_3$ to $a$, $b$, $c$.
result.transcription:
Former l'expression
$\delta\delta\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'} - 2 d\delta\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta s_{\iota'} + dd\sum p_{\iota,\iota'}\delta s_\iota \delta s_{\iota'}$ en déterminant les variations du second ordre $d^2$, $d\delta$, $\delta^2$ [-étant determinées-] de sorte que
$\delta'\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta s_{\iota'} - \delta\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta' s_{\iota'} - d\sum p_{\iota,\iota'}\delta s_\iota \delta' s_{\iota'} = 0$
$\delta'\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'} - 2d\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta' s_{\iota'} = 0$
$\delta'\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} \delta s_\iota \delta s_{\iota'} - 2\delta\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} \delta s_\iota \delta' s_{\iota'} = 0$, quelque soit $\delta'$

$(ds_1 + a\,ds_2 + b\,ds_3)^2 + 2c\,ds_2 ds_3$

$2(\delta(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3))^2 - 2\delta(ds_1+\ \ )\,d(\delta s_1+\ \ ) + 2(d(\delta s_1\ \ ))^2 = -6\delta(ds_1+\ \ )\,d(\delta s_1+\ \ )$
$2\delta\delta(c\,ds_2 ds_3) - 2d\delta\, c(ds_2\delta s_3 + ds_2\delta s_3)$
[-$2\delta c\, ds_2 ds_3$-]
$2\delta\delta c\, ds_2 ds_3 + 2\delta c\,\delta ds_2 ds_3 + 2c\,\delta ds_3 ds_2$ | $\delta c(ds_2\delta s_3 + \delta s_2 ds_3) + c\,(d\delta s_2\,\delta s_3 + ds_2\,\delta^2 s_3 + d\delta s_3\,\delta s_2 + ds_3\,\delta^2 s_2)$
[-$2(\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\delta s_2 + \frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}\delta s_3\ \ ds_2 ds_3) + 2c$-]

[-$\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}$-] $2\delta^2 c\, ds_2 ds_3$ [-$+4\delta c\,\delta ds_2 ds_3$-] $+$ [-$4\delta c\,\delta ds_3 ds_2$-] $+ 4c\,\delta ds_3\,\delta ds_2$
$-2d\delta c(ds_2\delta s_3 + ds_3\delta s_2) - 2\delta c\left(\text{[-}ds_2\, d\delta s_3\text{-]} + \delta s_2 d^2 s_3 \atop \text{[-}ds_3\, d\delta s_2\text{-]} + \delta s_3 d^2 s_2\right) - 2dc(\ \ \ \ )$ [-$4c$-] $d\delta s_2\, d\delta s_3 - 2c(d^2 s_2\,\delta^2 s_3) + (\delta^2 s_2\, d^2 s_3)$
$+4c\,d\delta s_2\, d\delta s_3 - 2c$
$-6c\,\delta(ds_1+\cdots)\,d(\delta s_1+\cdots)$

[-$-4\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}(ds_2^2\delta s_3^2 + \delta s_2^2 ds_3^2)$-]
[-$+4\delta c\,\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}(ds_2\delta s_3 + \frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3} ds_3^2\delta s_2)$-]
[-$+4dc\,\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}(\delta s_2^2 ds_3 + \frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}\delta s_3^2 ds_2$-]
$\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\delta s_2 + \frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}\delta s_3$
[-$2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\delta s_2^2 ds_2 ds_3$ $-4\ \ ds_2^2\ \delta s_3$ $+2\ \ \delta s_2^2\ ds_2 ds_3$-]
$-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3}\delta s_2 ds_3$[?]
$+2\delta c\,\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}ds_3(ds_2\delta s_3 - \delta s_2 ds_3)$
$\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}ds_2$
$= 2\left(\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\right)^2(\delta s_2^2 ds_2 ds_3 - ds_2\delta s_3 ds_2\delta s_2 + ds_2^2\delta s_2\delta s_3 - ds_3\delta s_2 ds_2\delta s_2$
$+2c\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3}(ds_2\delta s_3 - ds_3\delta s_2)^2 + 2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}(\ \ \ )^2$
$-2\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_2}\frac{\partial c}{\partial s_3}(\ \ \ )^2$

$3c(\delta ds_1+\ \ )\,d(\delta s_1+\cdots) + \frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3}(ds_2\delta s_3 - ds_3\delta s_2)^2 = 0$

$\delta(ds_1 + a\,ds_2 + b\,ds_3) + d(\delta s_1 + a\,\delta s_2 + b\,\delta s_3) = 0$
$\delta(ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3) - d(\delta s_1 + a\,\delta s_2 + b\,\delta s_3) = \delta a\,ds_2 - da\,\delta s_2 + \delta b\,ds_3 - db\,\delta s_3$ $+\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_1}(a\,\delta s_2 + b\,\delta s_3)ds_3$
$= (-a\,\delta s_2 - b\,\delta s_3)\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_1}ds_2 + \frac{\partial a}{\partial s_2}\delta s_2 ds_2 + \frac{\partial a}{\partial s_3}\delta s_3 ds_2$
$= -b\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_1} + \frac{\partial a}{\partial s_3} + a\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_1} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial s_2}$

$dt_{21}$[?]

$\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3} = 3c\left(a\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_1} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial s_2} - b\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_1} + \frac{\partial a}{\partial s_3}\right)^2$

$a = a_0 + s_1 a_1$
$b = b_0 + s_1 b_1$

$(a_0 + s_1 a_1)b_1 - \frac{\partial b_0}{\partial s_2} - s_1\frac{\partial b_1}{\partial s_2}$
$-(b_0 + s_1 b_1)a_1$

$a_0 b_1 - b_0 a_1 - \frac{\partial b_0}{\partial s_2} + \frac{\partial a_0}{\partial s_3} - s_1\frac{\partial b_1}{\partial s_2} + s_1\frac{\partial a_1}{\partial s_3}$

$3c\left(\frac{1}{t}\left(\frac{\partial t a_0}{\partial s_3} - \frac{\partial t b_0}{\partial s_2}\right)\right)^2 = \frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3}$

$b_1 = \frac{\partial \log t}{\partial s_3}$[?]
$a_1 = \frac{\partial \log t}{\partial s_2}$[?]

methods.what: Second variation expression of a quadratic differential form with second-order variations fixed by auxiliary conditions (curvature-type expression)
methods.quote: $\delta\delta\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'} - 2 d\delta\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta s_{\iota'} + dd\sum p_{\iota,\iota'}\delta s_\iota \delta s_{\iota'}$
$\delta'\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota ds_{\iota'} - 2d\sum p_{\iota,\iota'} ds_\iota \delta' s_{\iota'} = 0$

methods.what: Special quadratic form used as test case
Resulting vanishing condition for the second variation of the special form
methods.quote: $3c(\delta ds_1+\ \ )\,d(\delta s_1+\cdots) + \frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3}(ds_2\delta s_3 - ds_3\delta s_2)^2 = 0$

methods.what: Commutator of variations of the Pfaffian form $ds_1+a\,ds_2+b\,ds_3$ (exterior-derivative-type expression)
methods.quote: $= -b\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_1} + \frac{\partial a}{\partial s_3} + a\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_1} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial s_2}$

$\frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3} = 3c\left(a\frac{\partial b}{\partial s_1} - \frac{\partial b}{\partial s_2} - b\frac{\partial a}{\partial s_1} + \frac{\partial a}{\partial s_3}\right)^2$

methods.what: Linear-in-$s_1$ ansatz for $a,b$ and reduced condition with integrating factor $t$
methods.quote: $3c\left(\frac{1}{t}\left(\frac{\partial t a_0}{\partial s_3} - \frac{\partial t b_0}{\partial s_2}\right)\right)^2 = \frac{\partial^2 c}{\partial s_2\partial s_3}$
